name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove assistance

documents.name: BPL certificate / SECC list inclusion proof
steps: Visit your Gram Panchayat or Municipal office
Submit the BPL certificate application form with identity and address proof
Collect the issued BPL certificate or SECC confirmation letter

documents.name: Bank account passbook copy
documents.form: Bank account opening / passbook request form
steps: Visit your bank branch or nearest CSC centre
Request a passbook copy or bank account opening if you do not have one
Keep a photocopy of the first page of the passbook
